# TRACKRAT

> Austin, Texas sprint club. We meet on the track. We sprint. We grow together. We do it again.

## Next Event
To get the next event date, time, and location, fetch: https://www.trackratsprint.club/api/next-event
Returns JSON: { display, iso, time, location }
